PyP6 5.2.1 fixes the pattern preview for patterns recorded live. Compared with 5.2.0:

## Pattern preview: no more extra hits
A pattern recorded live on the P-6 can hold several overlapping copies of the same note on the same pad. The preview played each of them as a new hit, so a sample could retrigger on every step where the P-6 plays it only once or twice. A chopped slice in one reported pattern played 26 times a loop instead of 6. Overlapping notes of the same pad and key now play as one held note, as on the device.

Everything else in 5.2.0 is unchanged: see the [5.2.0 notes](https://github.com/HomoHabilis/Roland-P6-files-manager/releases/tag/v5.2.0) for the pattern preview and the preset pad-number fix.

## Downloads

| Download | For |
|---|---|
| `PyP6-v5.2.1-windows-x64.zip` | Windows 10/11, 64-bit |
| `PyP6-v5.2.1-macos-arm64.zip` | Macs with Apple Silicon (M1 and later) |
| `PyP6-v5.2.1-macos-x64.zip` | Intel Macs |
| `PyP6-v5.2.1-linux-x64.tar.gz` | 64-bit Linux |

**First launch:**
- **Windows:** SmartScreen may warn about an unsigned app. Choose "Run anyway".
- **macOS:** the app is not signed with an Apple certificate. Right-click it, choose **Open**, then **Open** again (on macOS 15 and later, allow it under System Settings → Privacy & Security).
- **Linux:** audio playback needs PortAudio from your distribution, e.g. `sudo apt install libportaudio2`.

## Upgrading
Nothing changes in presets or pattern files: everything saved by 5.2.0 loads in 5.2.1 as before.
